confirmed_spec_rules_summary: Merged PR is the default Event candidate.
Default-branch direct commit is a candidate ONLY when PR association lookup completed normally (COMPLETED) and observed NO_MATCH_OBSERVED.
UNKNOWN PR association is NEVER interpreted as NO_MATCH_OBSERVED (no PR).
Issue/ticket links attach as CONTEXT_ONLY and NEVER trigger automatic merging.
User manual merge is allowed ONLY within the same repository (and workspace) and is counted as a single USER_COMPOSITE without member double counting.
USER_COMPOSITE nesting is strictly forbidden (neither a USER_COMPOSITE root nor an already-subsumed member may be merged into another USER_COMPOSITE).
Dissolving a USER_COMPOSITE restores its constituent members and marks dependent Claims as stale.
